comment: pager.c look_engrs() formats each line's prefix with coord_desc() in the whatis_coord mode (2196-2214): '%12s' for compass and full compass, '%s' for screen. Segment 1 (compass) lists the engraving the hero stands on, which the hero's glyph obscures, then the same engraving from one step east. Segment 2 (full compass) lists nearby and all engravings from two steps away. Segment 3 (screen) drops an item on the engraving, so the line ends 'obscured by' the object, and lists all engravings.
